summary: Correct the Alpaca cache/retention attestations from DENIED to PENDING_RIGHTS_VERIFICATION. The DENIED value was an implementation default written by the coding assistant, not a documented contractual denial; no source was ever cited for it. This does not grant any cache right: persistent storage stays disabled until evidence supports it, and memory-only behaviour is unchanged.
owner_instruction: Owner correction on 2026-11-04: the existing ALPACA_BASIC / ALPACA_HISTORICAL cache_permitted = DENIED must not be presented as a verified contractual restriction without supporting evidence.

denial_source_audit.origin: Coding-assistant attestation in the V84 amendment, recorded as false with the wording 'the terms do not grant blanket storage'

behaviour_after_correction.memory_session: unchanged (necessary to use an authorised observation)
behaviour_after_correction.persistent_storage: disabled: provider_status reports the cache right as UNKNOWN, so a refresh remains memory-only
behaviour_after_correction.redistribution: disabled: no path in ACASH publishes provider data

unchanged: entitlement, display, calculation and derived-value attestations
